curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Before this foursome can challenge the lawless posse in Silverado, they must engineer a jailbreak and discover where their true loyalties lie.
curatedMovie.description: On the road to the frontier town of Silverado, four disparate travelers cross paths only to find their friends and family under the thumb of a corrupt sheriff and a deadly posse.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-moving and exciting, blending classic Western suspense with crowd-pleasing action.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Lawrence Kasdan delivers an energetic Western loaded with rapid-fire shootouts, sharp teamwork, and spirited frontier adventure.
